author: KiroV2
body: I am deeply sorry for what I said earlier (Kys XDXD). I meant to say it as a joke because the players joke was hilarious when he or she said "An apple away keeps a doctor away." It is the way I love to communicate with others when I meet them. Yes, I understand that it is your job and you must take it seriously. It is also fine that you temp-banned me for that because it is your job and I am deeply sorry for what I said. I should explain myself more next time. Yes I understand if you do not unban me. It is fine, but i just wanted to explain myself more on how I meant to say it. Thank you for reading this appeal and have a wonderful time! :D <3

replies.author: Protel
replies.body:
Hello, 

I appreciate you taking the time to appeal/explain your situation, however this appeal is denied. I highly suggest you find a different way to communicate with people you meet because that statement can be taken in all different sorts of interpretations, and all it takes it one person to take the it wrong way.

Thank you for understanding,
John
